title: 欧洲 LUCAS 2012–2018 作物序列类型点产品构建
summary: 从三期 Harmonised LUCAS 公开观测重建 21,620 点、八类语义标注的欧洲作物序列类型产品；v0.3 Base 要求自行设计非作者 PCA+Ward 的确定性分类方法。
evaluation: A hidden verifier checks the exact public-data product contract and proceeds strictly through 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, stopping at the first failed gate. Author-product agreement and independent agricultural validation are cumulative gates; 0.8/1.0 add progressively broader independent improvement.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
